data_source.citation: Jeon J-H, Lim A (2026), Biodiversity Data Journal 14:e191556, Table 3

mandatory_caveats: The published species-specific coefficient estimates and standard errors are reused rather than independently fitted to source event data.
The unknown cross-species covariance is bounded mathematically, but standard-error uncertainty, post-model-selection bias, model misspecification, and unmodelled site heterogeneity are NOT covered.
The response is conditional model-based camera detection p per site-season, not detector optical q, latent animal encounters, species abundance, actual temporal niche redistribution, or causation.
The original year-long summer-vs-winter season contrast cannot be re-labelled as the original early-May/June versus July/August 41 daylength-matched mirror pairs.
The six comparisons, including statistically unpersuasive ones, must all be reported; discovery remains exploratory, not a novel preregistered confirmatory test.
A species contrast in model p does not establish differences in temporal phase, habitat competition, phenology, or thermoregulation.
